title: S7 Delivery, Issue Context and ISO 19650 Decision Reference

entries.name: ISO 19650 CDE Information States
entries.note: For ISO 19650-governed exchange, the states form a lifecycle with governed transitions: Work in Progress to Shared follows approval for sharing (Decision A mapping), and Shared to Published follows the applicable authorization and acceptance process (Decision B mapping). Archived preserves the historical record.

entries.name: ISO 19650 Exchange Decisions
states: Decision B - authorization and acceptance for publication
entries.note: Decision A maps Work in Progress to Shared. Decision B maps Shared to Published. Where ISO 19650-2 delivery provisions apply, the delivery sequence distinguishes task-team submission, lead-appointed-party review and authorization, lead-appointed-party submission, and appointing-party review and acceptance.

entries.name: ISO 19650-2 Information Model Delivery Sequence
states: 5.7.1 task team submits information model for lead appointed party authorization
5.7.2 lead appointed party reviews and authorizes information model
5.7.3 lead appointed party submits information model for appointing party acceptance
5.7.4 appointing party reviews and accepts information model
entries.note: This sequence is the canonical ISO delivery backbone for applicable ISO 19650-2 exchanges; TIVERIT supplementary decisions shall not replace or rename these ISO activities.

entries.name: Deliverable Issue Contexts
states: Formal Submission / Issued for Declared Use
entries.note: Issue labels declare context, status or intended use. They shall be interpreted with the applicable ISO exchange process and project information requirements and do not independently assign ISO party responsibility.

entries.name: TIVERIT Supplementary Governance Decisions
entries.note: These TIVERIT controls may support or follow the ISO 19650 process but are not replacements for Decision A, Decision B, or the ISO 19650-2 5.7.1-5.7.4 delivery activities. Their applicability and authority basis must be separately governed.

deprecated_semantics.reason: Deprecated as an unqualified generic gateway state. For applicable ISO 19650-2 delivery, identify the actual appointing-party acceptance activity and resulting transition; for supplementary TIVERIT decisions identify the specific decision separately.
Not a universal ISO 19650 decision state. It may be used as a project-defined status/permitted-use code only when its meaning, reliance conditions and governing project requirements are explicit.

Not by itself evidence of a supplementary handover-acceptance decision or operational reliance. Treat as a project-defined record/submission context unless the applicable project governance establishes additional consequences.

provenance.migration_note: ISO-IMP-005 re-audit establishes Decision A / Decision B and the ISO 19650-2 5.7.1-5.7.4 sequence as the ISO exchange backbone. Quality verification, coordination sign-off, milestone approval and handover acceptance are retained only as clearly identified TIVERIT/project supplementary governance decisions.
